name: gap-south-india-initials
description: Chennai paint distributor, single side. South-Indian naming: initial-first single given name 'S. Karthikeyan' (no dictionary surname, one 'real' word), degree line 'B.E., M.B.A.' under it, 'Managing Partner'. Company carries the honorific-looking prefix 'Sri' ('Sri Murugan Agencies') that also appears in NAME_PREFIX, printed in Title Case; Tamil-script shop name above it OCR'd by the eng model into Latin junk. 'Authorised Distributors :' brand list with pipes. Phones use SUFFIX labels in brackets — '044-2434 5678 (O), 2434 5679 (R)' — with the second landline lacking its STD code (R = residence = home phone; the bench cannot assert home-phone so only (O) is checked), plus 'Cell :' with a leading-zero 11-digit mobile '098410 12345' and a plain one. yahoo.co.in free-mail (must not become the website), 'Chennai - 600 017' spaced PIN followed by state abbreviation 'T.N.' on the next line, GSTIN with state code 33.
